A review of recent medical applications of **LIBS elemental imaging**, including endogenous and exogenous elements in biological tissues and perspectives for preclinical and clinical use.

Published in *Médecine/Sciences* (2019). DOI: [10.1051/medsci/2019132](https://doi.org/10.1051/medsci/2019132).
